description: This file contains unit tests for the CustomFieldDao class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin module. It tests functionalities such as retrieving, deleting, searching, saving, and updating custom fields, as well as verifying if certain fields are in use.

classes.name: CustomFieldDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for testing the CustomFieldDao data access object, verifying CRUD operations, search filters, and usage checks for custom fields in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of CustomFieldDao and populating test data from a fixture.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a custom field by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteCustomField
methods.description: Tests deletion of custom fields by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchCustomField
methods.description: Tests retrieving custom fields with default search parameters.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithLimit
methods.description: Tests retrieving a limited number of custom fields.

methods.name: testSaveCustomField
methods.description: Tests saving a new custom field and verifies fields auto-population like field number.

methods.name: testEditCustomField
methods.description: Tests updating an existing custom field.

methods.name: testGetSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Verifies count of custom fields matching search criteria.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithScreen
methods.description: Tests filtering custom fields by screen.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithFieldNumbers
methods.description: Tests filtering custom fields by specific field numbers.

methods.name: testIsCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Checks if certain custom fields are in use.

methods.name: testUpdateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Verifies update operations when a drop-down value is in use.
